context.person: A person using a fitness class booking application
context.journey_stage: Canceled class offers a waitlist alternative
context.user_goal: Join a waitlist without a guarantee or choose an available class.

product_state.preceding_state: An instructor canceled a yoga class and a similar later class currently has a waitlist.
product_state.current_state: The original class is canceled. The class credit was returned.
known_facts: The later class is not guaranteed.
The person can join its waitlist or use the credit for any available class.
forbidden_claims: The person is enrolled in the later class.
The credit was refunded to a card.
Joining the waitlist spends the credit.

current_content.title: An update
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand canceled class offers a waitlist alternative, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the later class and join its waitlist.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Browse available classes using the returned credit.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The original booking will not occur.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Join a waitlist without a guarantee or choose an available class.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
